The SMILES string we used was placeholder "...". Need actual SMILES. Let's construct the target SMILES correctly.

Original first precursor SMILES: 
"C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO"

Replace "C(=O)O" with "C=O". The substring "C(=O)O" appears within ".../C(=O)O)". So new substring "C=O". So new SMILES:

"C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO"

Check if valid. We'll use that.

Now call search_template_catalog_by_criteria with that SMILES.
